aiResearchSummary.text: Eclypsium is engaged in research and development focused on methods and systems for hardware and firmware security monitoring. Their work involves systems and methods for monitoring and identifying potential security vulnerabilities in hardware and firmware of host devices, utilizing a client system with a data interface, processor, and storage device to execute instructions for vulnerability detection. This highlights Eclypsium’s focus on securing IT infrastructure at the hardware and firmware level.
